name: TraceForge
description: Signal paths, via stitching, BGA fanout and live PCB visualization in KiCad PCB Editor
description_full: TraceForge combines signal path timing, trace cleanup, via stitching, via array placement, RF via fencing, BGA fanout and live net visualization in one PCB Editor panel. The Via Array tab fits selected existing vias into an evenly spaced grid within their current bounds. The Visualization tab sets per-group and per-net colors, filters the ratsnest by selected components, and opens KiCad's native teardrop editor. It reads the live board through KiCad 10's pcbnew Python bindings. Supports Windows and KiCad 10 only. See the project homepage for documentation and known limits.
